questions.question: The marginal propensity to consume, lies between ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 0 to 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Marginal propensity to consume refers to the** ratio of change in consumption expenditure to change in total income.**
 
• **MPC = Change in consumption (ΔC) / Change in Income (ΔY)**
 
• The marginal propensity to consume lies **between 0 to 1 **as we know incremental income is either spent on consumption or saved for future use.
 
• **If the entire income is consumed, i.e. ΔS = 0, then MPC = 1 and if the entire additional income is saved, i.e. ΔC = 0, then MPC = 0. So, 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: Which is the chief crop of Sri Lanka in which the country is self-sufficient?
questions.solution:
• Thechief crop of Sri Lanka in which country is self-sufficient is ‘Rice’.
 
• Rice is cultivated during ‘Maha’ and ‘Yala’ seasons. Maha Season starts by September and ends by March during North-east monsoon, and Yala season starts by May and ends by August.
 
• Tea is also cultivated in the central highlands and is a major source of foreign exchange. Vegetables, fruits and oilseed crops are also cultivated in the country.

Hence, 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a nuclear reactor, ‘cadmium rods’ are used as which of the following?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Controller.**__

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• A nuclear reactor produces and controls the release of energy from splitting the atoms of certain elements. In a nuclear power reactor, the energy released is used as heat to make steam to generate electricity. **Hence, the controller is the correct answer.**

 
• **FUEL:__** Uranium is the basic fuel. Usually, pellets of uranium oxide (UO₂₎ are arranged in tubes to form fuel rods. The rods are arranged into fuel assemblies in the reactor core.
 
• **__Moderator:__** Material in the core slows down the neutrons released from fission so that they cause more fission. It is usually water but may be heavy water or graphite.
 
• **__Controller:__** These are made with neutron-absorbing material such as __cadmium__, hafnium or boron, and are inserted or withdrawn from the core to control the rate of reaction, or to halt it.
 
• **__Lubricant:__** lubricant has shown that it is possible to produce materials capable of lubricating some reactor components. In order to further the development of such lubricants the U.K.A.E.A. and the nuclear manufacturing groups have co-operated in providing lubricant manufacturers.

questions.question: Which of the following is used in gunpowder?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Potassium Nitrate.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• The major composition of **Gunpowder** includes **Potassium nitrate**, Carbon and Sulfur. Hence, Option 2, **Potassium Nitrate** is the correct answer.

 
• The standard composition of Gun powder is 75% potassium nitrate, 15% charcoal or carbon and 10% sulphur. The formula is well accepted and is known for ages as one which will produce a powerful black powder.
 
• The sulfur and charcoal act as fuels while the potassium nitrate is an oxidizer.

questions.question: On the basis of whose recommendations the Union Ministry of Minority Affairs has ended the ‘Haj subsidy’ from 2018?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Afzal Amanullah Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Haj subsidy was a subsidy that was given to Indian **Muslim Hajj pilgrims **by the Government of India in form of discounted Airfares on Indian Government-owned Air India. 

 
• The Union Ministry of Minority Affairs has decided to end the **‘Haj subsidy’ **this year as a part of its policy to empower minorities with dignity and without appeasement.
 
• This decision was taken based on the recommendations of the **‘Afzal Amanullah Committee' **and the May 2012 Supreme Court order.

questions.question: Calculate the frequency (in Hz) of a sound wave of wavelength 5 m travelling with a speed of 360 m/s.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__72__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Frequency = Speed of sound/Wavelength
 
• Speed of sound = 360 m/s
 
• Wavelength = 5 m
 
• Frequency = 360/5 = 72 Hz

Hence, option 4, **72Hz is** the correct answer.

questions.question: In a sound wave compressions are regions where density _____.

options.text: as well as pressure is high.
as well as pressure is low.
is high and pressure is low
is low and pressure is high

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**as well as pressure is high.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• In physics, the sound is a vibration that typically propagates as an audible wave of pressure, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid.

 
• The sound waves are generated by a sound source, such as the vibrating diaphragm of a stereo speaker. The sound source creates vibrations in the surrounding medium, the vibrations propagate away from the source at the speed of sound, thus forming the sound wave. 
 
• Wave's features: Compression is a high-density part of the wave (the part where the slinky is compressed). It is the peak of the wave. A rarefaction is a low-density part of the wave (the part where the slinky is most spread out). This is the trough of the wave.
 
• Compression is a region in a longitudinal wave where the particles are closest together creating both density and pressure high. Hence, 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Soil contains decayed remains of living organisms. This is called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Humus**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Humus is a dark, organic matter that forms in soil when a plant or living matter decays. 
 
• Humus is formed by the decomposing action of soil microorganisms (e.g., bacteria and fungi), which break down animal and vegetable material into elements that can be used by growing plants. 
 
• Humus is an important biological constituent of fertile soil.
 
• It contains many useful nutrients for healthy soil. One of the most important is nitrogen. Nitrogen is a key nutrient for most plants. 
 
• Agriculture depends on nitrogen and other nutrients found in humus.
 
• When humus is in soil, the soil will crumble, and water moves easily through the loose soil so that oxygen can reach the roots of plants.
 
• When people compost, they collect decaying organic material, such as food and garden scraps, that turned into soil, It produces Humus in soil.
